verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-prevention API platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence documents only REST endpoints, language SDKs, the Beacon JS snippet, platform plugins and a self-service Integration Console, with no command-line tool. SDKs and the Integration Console are adjacent developer building blocks and earn no credit toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
